assign.request: Minion 2 of page-drawer: select any content element while the drawer is open, show its properties in the drawer, and a chip in the AI tab input that sends the element as context (brief: ../m2-select-chip.md). Also: the tab strip must show all five tabs at 19rem and at the narrowest drag width.
assign.now: fixing the tab strip, then reading ext/Ask pick()

log.msg: Tab strip fix: at 1920 the page type is larger at the same 19rem, so Admin clipped. The strip now wraps (flex-wrap) and never scrolls; measured every tab fully visible at 1280/1920/3440 and at the 200px drag floor.

Proof pngs cannot be committed: .gitignore line 14 ignores public/framework/ai/**/shots/. They stay on disk in the worktree; the docs' own screenshots (ext/drawer/doc/tabs.png, select.png) are committed.
ext/Ask seam (the one allowed edit there): context() also returns file, the page.js that drew the element (pick.js page_at).

decision.question: How are hover and selection marked on the element?
decision.why: the element's classes are what the Element tab reports and what ext/Ask maps to an owning module via css-scopes.txt; a drawer- class made every selected element report ext/drawer as its module (seen on the card shot)

decision.question: Where do the selected element's properties show?
options: a section on top of the AI tab
a sixth tab, Element, routed like the rest
decision.why: one tab per job keeps the AI tab a chat; it is routed (?drawer=element) and the chip is the bridge into the AI tab

decision.question: When is selecting on?
options: only while the drawer shows its own tabs
decision.chose: only while it shows its own tabs
decision.why: ext/layout's panel uses the same drawer and has its own clicks; selecting over it would steal them

assign.outcome:
**While the drawer is open, a click on any paragraph, heading, list item or card selects it. The new Element tab shows what it is and where it lives, and "Ask about this" puts it on the AI input as a chip that goes along with every message.**

![A paragraph selected and its properties](/framework/ext/drawer/doc/select.png)

- The send carries `context: [{kind, label, text, selector}]`, the agreed shape; the logged body is in [request-body.json](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/page-drawer/m2/request-body.json).
- With the drawer shut, nothing changes: clicks select nothing and links work.
- The tab strip now wraps, so every tab is visible at every width.
- Proof: [m2/proof.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-28/page-drawer/m2/proof.md) · how it works: [doc/select](/framework/ext/drawer/doc/select/)

Committed on `worktree/page-drawer`, not merged. The proof pngs are gitignored (`ai/**/shots/`), so they stay in the worktree.
